node.statement: For the data chosen in 1.1, Q_lambda is row-stochastic and ||Q_lambda^2-Q_lambda||_{infinity->infinity}<=eta_lambda. Indeed, def-positive-approximate-retract says that the matrices of the positive unital maps A_lambda and M_lambda have probability-vector rows. Hence their product Q_lambda has nonnegative entries and row sums one, so it is row-stochastic by def-stochastic. A probability-row matrix has infinity-to-infinity operator norm one (its maximum absolute row sum is one), so ||A_lambda||=||M_lambda||=1. Matrix associativity and the identity maps on the relevant spaces give Q_lambda^2-Q_lambda=A_lambda M_lambda A_lambda M_lambda-A_lambda I_2 M_lambda=A_lambda(M_lambda A_lambda-I_2)M_lambda. Submultiplicativity, 1.1, and eta_lambda=2*lambda^2 therefore give ||Q_lambda^2-Q_lambda||<=||A_lambda|| ||M_lambda A_lambda-I_2|| ||M_lambda||=eta_lambda. This is precisely the weak defect bound in def-almost-idempotent whenever eta_lambda<1/4.
